items.question: What is the Sitecore XM Cloud Starter Kit?
items.answer: It is a Next.js-based reference implementation designed to accelerate development on Sitecore XM Cloud using modern tooling and best practices.

items.question: Does the starter kit support AEO and GEO?
items.answer: Yes. It includes semantic HTML, JSON-LD structured data, an LLM sitemap, and AI-specific endpoints required by the GEO contract.

items.question: Which frameworks are supported?
items.answer: The starter kit is optimized for Next.js App Router and Sitecore Content SDK, with full support for SSR, SSG, and server components.

items.question: How do I get started with the starter kit?
items.answer: Clone the repository, copy .env.remote.example to .env.local, configure your XM Cloud credentials, run npm install, and then npm run dev to start development.

items.question: What locales are supported out of the box?
items.answer: The starter kit supports English (en) and Canadian English (en-CA) with automatic locale detection and dictionary-based translations.

items.question: Can I customize the components?
items.answer: Yes. All components are built with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/ui, making them highly customizable through utility classes and design tokens.

items.question: How do I deploy the starter kit?
items.answer: The starter kit can be deployed to XM Cloud using the xmcloud.build.json configuration, or to any hosting platform that supports Next.js applications.
